info.title: SCAR Backend
info.description: Backend for SCAR - Smart Cybersecurity Autonomous Response Drone

post.description:
Store an event that is already in the unified format. Raw Zeek/Wazuh events go to /api/v1/ingest/{source}.

Send an optional `dedup_key`: if that key is already stored, the existing event is returned with 200
and nothing new is saved.
Store an AI result using the event_id provided by the automation team.

Receive the agreed Wazuh/Zeek alert format through the authenticated webhook.

A Wazuh alert that was already stored (same alert_id) is not stored again: the existing alert is
returned with 200 instead of 201.

Receive raw events, convert them to the unified format, and store them with the raw event.

Sending the same event again (retry after a network failure) does not create a second alert: it is
counted in `duplicates` and the existing id is returned in `duplicate_ids`.

schema.description: One raw event (JSON object) or a list of raw events, in the ORIGINAL Zeek / Wazuh format
schema.title: Body

get.description: Latest known state of every drone.
GPS path of a drone (only readings that have a position). Newest first.

post.description: Security event detected by the drone itself, sent immediately.
